en: Where did you go on holiday?
zh: 你假期去了哪里？
grammar_point: 一般过去时特殊疑问句

en: I didn't go anywhere special, but I tried something new — I worked as a tour guide at a museum.
zh: 我没去什么特别的地方，但尝试了新事物——我在博物馆当了一回导游。
grammar_point: 不定代词 anywhere；一般过去时

en: Did you do anything interesting on your holiday?
zh: 你假期做了什么有趣的事吗？

en: No, nothing special. But I met someone interesting.
zh: 没有，没什么特别的。不过我遇到了一个有趣的人。

en: Did you go anywhere interesting?
zh: 你去什么有趣的地方了吗？

en: Yes, I went to Yunnan.
zh: 是的，我去了云南。

en: Did you go with anyone?
zh: 你是和别人一起去的吗？

en: Yes, I went with my family.
zh: 是的，我和家人一起去的。

en: Did you eat anything special?
zh: 你吃了什么特别的东西吗？

en: Yes, we did! Everything tasted good, especially the steamed chicken soup. Everyone loved it.
zh: 是的！每样东西都好吃，尤其是汽锅鸡。大家都很喜欢。

en: How was your holiday?
zh: 你的假期怎么样？

en: It was fantastic.
zh: 太棒了。

en: Yes, we stayed in the old town for a few days, and we enjoyed it very much.
zh: 是的，我们在老城住了几天，玩得很开心。

en: Did you visit Yulong Mountain?
zh: 你去玉龙雪山了吗？
grammar_point: 一般过去时一般疑问句

en: It is! It just took my breath away.
zh: 是的！它让我惊叹不已。

en: What about you?
zh: 你呢？

en: I just stayed at home to read, play games, and relax, but it was still fun.
zh: 我就待在家里看书、玩游戏、放松，但假期仍然很有趣。
grammar_point: 不定式表目的；but 并列

en: How was your summer holiday?
zh: 你的暑假过得怎么样？

zh: 请你扫扫地好吗？

en: Would you like to mop the floor or clean the windows?
zh: 你想拖地还是擦窗？

en: The windows are really clean, and they look like mirrors.
zh: 窗户很干净，看起来像镜子一样。

en: Jim, can you help me put up the pictures on the wall?
zh: 吉姆，你能帮我把画挂到墙上吗？

exam_point: 情态动词 can/could 请求许可

zh: 妈妈，待会你能带我去超市吗？
exam_point: 情态动词 can/could 请求许可

zh: 你现在能载我去镇上吗？

zh: 莱克先生，我可以用一下洗手间吗？

zh: 我可以待到十一点吗？

en: There are more activities this year.
zh: 今年有更多的活动。

en: It is more colourful than last year.
zh: 它比去年更丰富多彩。

en: Emma is taller than Ella, but her hair is shorter than Ella's.
zh: 艾玛比埃拉高，但头发比埃拉短。

en: Ella dances better than Emma, but Emma sings louder than her.
zh: 埃拉舞跳得比艾玛好，但艾玛唱歌比她响。

en: Emma always gets up earlier than me, but I work as hard as her!
zh: 艾玛总比我起得早，但我工作和她一样努力！

en: As twins, you look very similar. How are you different?
zh: 作为双胞胎，你们长得很像。你们有什么不同？

en: There are more students and more activities this year.
zh: 今年学生更多，活动也更多。

en: Emma is funnier than me.
zh: 艾玛比我更有趣。

en: We're different in many ways, but together, we make a great team!
zh: 我们在很多方面不同，但合在一起就是很棒的团队！

en: Is Julie slimmer than you?
zh: 朱莉比你瘦吗？

en: No, she isn't. She is as slim as me.
zh: 不，她和我一样瘦。

en: Sam is as serious as Tom.
zh: 萨姆和汤姆一样认真。

en: Congratulations on winning the prize at the school music festival!
zh: 祝贺你在学校音乐节上获奖！

en: The blue whale is the largest and heaviest animal in the world.
zh: 蓝鲸是世界上最大、最重的动物。

en: The biggest land animal in the world is the African elephant.
zh: 世界上最大的陆生动物是非洲象。

en: The cheetah runs the fastest among all land animals.
zh: 猎豹在所有陆生动物中跑得最快。

en: I think the most useful plant in the world is bamboo.
zh: 我认为世界上最实用的植物是竹子。

en: It is perhaps the most interesting plant in the world.
zh: 它也许是世界上最有趣的植物。

en: It's one of the most popular subjects in Chinese paintings.
zh: 它是中国画中最受欢迎的题材之一。

en: It's a symbol of goodness in Chinese culture.
zh: 它是中国文化中善良的象征。

en: I learnt lots of interesting things when I was there.
zh: 我在那儿学到了很多有趣的东西。

en: Bamboo is one of the fastest-growing plants.
zh: 竹子是生长最快的植物之一。

en: People can use it to build houses and make tools and instruments.
zh: 人们可以用它建房子、做工具和乐器。

en: I remember pandas love to eat bamboo too.
zh: 我记得熊猫也喜欢吃竹子。

en: Actually we eat bamboo shoots too. They're really delicious.
zh: 事实上我们也吃竹笋。它们真的很好吃。

en: I think they are the cutest animals in the world.
zh: 我认为它们是世界上最可爱的动物。

en: What an amazing smell it is!
zh: 多香啊！

en: What a mess it is!
zh: 真是一团糟！

en: What luck we have!
zh: 我们多有运气啊！

en: How delicious the dish looks!
zh: 这菜看起来多美味啊！

en: How clever you are!
zh: 你真聪明！

en: How wonderful life is!
zh: 生活多美好啊！

en: Can you teach me how to cook a popular Chinese dish?
zh: 你能教我做一道 popular 的中国菜吗？

en: How about stir-fried eggs and tomatoes?
zh: 西红柿炒鸡蛋怎么样？

en: We need eggs, tomatoes, oil and salt.
zh: 我们需要鸡蛋、西红柿、油和盐。

en: How many tomatoes and eggs do we need?
zh: 我们需要多少西红柿和鸡蛋？

en: First, cut the tomatoes into small pieces.
zh: 首先，把西红柿切成小块。

en: Then, heat some oil in a pan and add the tomatoes to it.
zh: 然后，在锅里热油，把西红柿放进去。

en: Next, cook the tomatoes in the pan until they're soft.
zh: 接着，把西红柿在锅里炒到变软。

en: What an amazing dish! What's next?
zh: 多棒的一道菜啊！下一步做什么？

en: Finally, put the eggs back into the pan and mix them with the tomatoes.
zh: 最后，把鸡蛋倒回锅里，和西红柿拌匀。

en: To make a banana milk shake, you need three bananas, one tablespoon of ice cream, and a cup of milk.
zh: 做香蕉奶昔需要三根香蕉、一勺冰淇淋和一杯牛奶。

en: What do you want to be in the future?
zh: 你将来想做什么工作？

en: I want to be an IT engineer.
zh: 我想成为一名 IT 工程师。
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: How do you plan to do that?
zh: 你打算怎么做？

en: I'm going to work hard at maths.
zh: 我打算努力学数学。
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: Are you going to read more books about IT?
zh: 你打算读更多关于 IT 的书吗？

en: What else are you going to do?
zh: 你还打算做什么？

en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
zh: 你长大后想做什么？

en: I want to be a fireman.
zh: 我想当一名消防员。

zh: 你打算怎么做到？

en: I'm going to exercise every day, because a fireman needs to be strong.
zh: 我打算每天锻炼，因为消防员需要强壮。

en: I'm going to read more classics.
zh: 我打算读更多经典作品。
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: I'm going to keep on writing every day.
zh: 我会坚持每天写作。

en: I think you're going to be a great writer.
zh: 我认为你会成为一名伟大的作家。

en: Not everyone knows what they want to be.
zh: 不是每个人都知道自己想做什么。

en: Just make sure you try your best at school.
zh: 只要确保你在学校尽力就好。

en: What are you reading?
zh: 你在读什么？

en: Shall we go to see the sci-fi film?
zh: 我们一起去看科幻电影好吗？

en: What will the future be like?
zh: 未来会是什么样子？
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: There will be more people in cities, but there will be fewer traffic accidents.
zh: 城市里会有更多人，但交通事故会更少。
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: Will most people live in outer space?
zh: 大多数人会住在太空吗？
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: How long will people live?
zh: 人们会活多久？
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: More people will live to be over 100 years old.
zh: 更多人将会活到一百岁以上。
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: I'm watching a video about future predictions.
zh: 我在看一个关于未来预测的视频。

en: I think there will be more robots, but the transport system will be more efficient.
zh: 我认为会有更多机器人，但交通系统会更高效。

en: Students probably won't go to a school in the future.
zh: 将来学生可能不用去学校上学。

en: They will study at home or any place they want.
zh: 他们会在家或任何想去的地方学习。

en: There will be better health care technology in our homes.
zh: 我们的家里会有更好的医疗技术。
exam_point: 将来时 will / be going to

en: Machines will tell us how to solve small health problems before they become bigger.
zh: 机器会在小健康问题变大之前告诉我们如何解决。

en: What an exciting sci-fi film! I really loved the story.
zh: 多刺激的科幻电影！我太喜欢这个故事了。

en: If you want to solve the problem, a face-to-face talk usually works the best.
zh: 如果你想解决问题，面对面谈谈通常最有效。

en: Texting can make things worse if you're not careful with your words.
zh: 如果你不注意用词，发短信可能让事情更糟。

en: If the rehearsal ends at 7:00 p.m., I'll pick you up at 7:15 p.m.
zh: 如果排练七点结束，我七点一刻来接你。

en: If you stay calm and say sorry, it will help.
zh: 如果你保持冷静并道歉，会有所帮助。

en: If I go there, I will try all the delicious local food.
zh: 如果我去那里，我会尝遍所有美味的当地食物。

en: If we have a face-to-face meeting, we'll understand each other better.
zh: 如果我们面对面见面，我们会更了解彼此。

en: If you need to leave, you can write things down for him.
zh: 如果你需要离开，你可以把事情写下来给他。

en: If you can't reach her by phone, I'll call you right away.
zh: 如果你打电话找不到她，我马上打给你。

en: Meeting in person is not always easy.
zh: 亲自见面并不总是容易的。

en: Some of you may prefer texting, but be careful with your words.
zh: 有些人可能更喜欢发短信，但要注意用词。

en: I'll call and try to meet, because friendship is important.
zh: 我会打电话并设法见面，因为友谊很重要。

en: If you give a cat some milk, she will become your friend.
zh: 如果你给猫一些牛奶，她就会成为你的朋友。
